headline: Iran opens third Tehran Basij training centre, plans to train 1 million volunteers
dek: Iran opened its third military training centre in Tehran (two prior centres opened Aug and Sep 2026) and announced plans to train 1 million paramilitary (Basij) volunteers nationwide under the Janfada campaign (registration since March; courses: urban defence, weapons handling, air defence,…
sources: ISNA (Iranian semiofficial agency) via Al Jazeera liveblog; DT Next (unregistered tier, attribution only)
